releases.summary: Ensembyte 1.1.2 delivers major stability and performance enhancements across file tree watching, child process management, background task synchronization with Claude, and multi-chat git isolation.

sections.title: Bug fixes & Stability
items: WorkingTreeWatch freeze fix: Resolved a deadlock in file-tree watching where concurrent callers looped without suspending, eliminating intermittent app beachballs and freezes during agent file edits.

Child process & memory management: Implemented full process-tree tracking via kernel APIs (proc_pidinfo, proc_listchildpids) ensuring child and grandchild agent processes cleanly terminate without leaking memory or leaving orphan zombies. Added 32MB input queue and 256MB backlog safety limits.

Claude background task sync: Fixed unprompted turn synchronization when Claude Code completes background commands, and added real-time "Waiting on a background task" mini spinner indicators to the sidebar.
Hydra multi-chat isolation: Prevented cross-chat write claiming and race conditions when multiple chat threads operate concurrently within the same checkout.
Offline Antigravity guard: Skipped headless usage queries when offline to avoid unexpected browser sign-in popups.

releases.summary: Ensembyte 1.1.1 updates the default working line style to a clean line, improves Hydra thread-mode status indicators and animations, and introduces dynamic platform adaptation on the website.

sections.title: New features
items: Working line default: Changed the default working line style in Conversation settings to a clean line ("Line") instead of "Card".
Hydra thread-mode indicators: Live rotating working vocabulary ticker, animated mini thinking spinners, persona glyphs, and smooth spring physics transitions for child heads in the sidebar.
Dynamic platform landing page: Website now automatically detects the user's operating system (macOS, Windows, Linux) and dynamically updates platform highlights, hero text, and call-to-actions.

sections.title: Bug fixes
items: Stabilized Swift CodeQL build workflow and updated codeql-action to v4.
Resolved Rust clippy warnings and restored backward-compatible environment variable fallbacks.

releases.summary: Ensembyte 1.1.0 introduces Hydra Thread View to the sidebar and live status glyphs for child heads.

sections.title: New features
items: Hydra Thread View: Hydra heads can now run in a new dedicated thread on the sidebar instead of a floating panel. Right-click any lead thread with Hydra enabled and choose "Switch to Thread View" to migrate heads into individual sidebar rows with full status glyphs. Switch back to floating panel mode anytime from the same menu.
Head row status: Each Hydra head now shows its live status glyph (thinking, done, error) directly in its sidebar row, matching the floating panel indicator.

sections.title: Bug fixes
items: Fixed sidebar layout for threads with many Hydra heads in thread mode.

releases.summary: Initial public release of Ensembyte for macOS: a high-performance native desktop app for coding agents. Apple silicon, macOS 26 or later.

sections.title: New features
items: Multi-Agent Orchestration: Codex, Claude, Cursor, OpenCode, Grok, DeepSeek, Meta, Devin, and Antigravity in unified threads.
Real-Time Streaming UI: Inline approval tabs, interactive prompts, and permission requests.
Thread Isolation: Dedicated git worktree per thread so parallel agents never touch the same checkout.
Integrated Terminal: Fast, low-latency native terminal attached under every thread.
Turn-by-Turn Diff Viewer: Rich file inspection and side-by-side reviews for every agent turn.
Command Palette: Instant fuzzy navigation across all projects, threads, and actions in one keystroke.
Tinted-Glass Themes: 26 light and dark themes including Catppuccin, Dracula, Tokyo Night, Nord, Gruvbox, and Solarized.
Model Context Protocol (MCP): Complete support for stdio and remote MCP servers, tools, and resources.
